scope: native ratio4/ratio128/rotated compressor components, not full Attention/model/paged cache

configuration.weight_storage: checkpoint BF16/FP32, explicit load-time FP32 conversion
configuration.quantization: non-RoPE FP8 QDQ block64 or Hadamard + FP4 QDQ block32

reference_scope.published: unchanged upstream Compressor.forward: initial prefill and single-token decode
reference_scope.incremental_python: existing project Compressor: matching multi-token chunk schedule, NOT original full-prefill oracle

full_vs_chunk_numerical_gate: not claimed by this same-schedule native migration test

contract.outputs: packed E2M1 [...,K/2], scale [...,K/32] or BF16 QDQ
BF16 [...,N]; FP32 accumulation; no activation requantization

contract.inputs: FP8 A[...,K], packed E2M1 B[N,K/2]; scales A[...,K/128], B[N,K/32]
contract.outputs: BF16 [...,N]; FP32 accumulation; W4A8, not W4A4

contract.inputs: BF16 Q[B,S,H,D], latent[B,L,D]; FP32 sink[H]; int32 indices[B,S,T], -1=invalid
contract.outputs: BF16 [B,S,H,D]; indexed attention with sink in softmax denominator

contract.inputs: BF16/FP32 X[...,K], matching W[N,K]; same device
contract.outputs: matching dtype [...,N]; no weight or activation quantization

contract.inputs: BF16/FP32 X[B,S,G,K], matching W[G,N,K]; same device
contract.outputs: matching dtype [B,S,G,N]; separate weight matrix per group

contract.inputs: BF16/FP32 scores[B,S,C], k<=C, explicit published/index_ascending tie policy
contract.outputs: integer indices[B,S,k], descending scores; tie policy must be honored

contract.inputs: FP32 HC weighted terms, explicit reduction axis
contract.outputs: FP32 sum with that axis removed; no dtype conversion

contract.inputs: BF16/FP32 X[...,D], epsilon; square/mean in the input dtype

contract.outputs: X dtype [...,D]; FP32 normalization and weight multiplication

contract.inputs: BF16/FP32 X[B,S,(H),R], complex64 frequencies[S,R/2], inverse flag
contract.outputs: same X storage; adjacent-pair FP32 complex rotation
BF16 [B,S,C]; BF16 dot/ReLU/product/reduction; no causal mask

contract.inputs: FP32 logits[T,E]; score function, top-k, scale; FP32 bias[E] or hash IDs[T,K]
contract.outputs: FP32 weights[T,K], integer expert IDs[T,K]; bias affects selection only

contract.inputs: FP32 projected values/scores[B,(G),R,D], scores may contain -inf
contract.outputs: FP32 [B,G,D] or decode [B,1,D]; softmax/reduction on R preserving input rank

contract.inputs: BF16 gate/up[T,I], clamp limit; optional FP32 routing weights[T,1]
contract.outputs: BF16 [T,I]; FP32 SwiGLU, route scaling BEFORE BF16 cast and down projection

contract.inputs: BF16 X[T,D], FP32 weights[T,K], distinct in-range integer expert IDs[T,K], E
contract.outputs: ExpertDispatch: owned packed hidden/weights/token IDs and device offsets; expert-ID-major stable order

contract.inputs: BF16 expert outputs[R,D] in ExpertDispatch order; dispatch metadata
contract.outputs: FP32 [T,D]; accumulate in ascending expert ID, no route reweighting or shared expert
